entries.en: Improved plugin loading performance in remote sessions
entries.zh: 改进远程会话中的插件加载性能

entries.en: Fixed mid-stream connection drops: partial responses are now preserved instead of showing a raw error, and the spinner no longer gets stuck at "running tool"
entries.zh: 修复了中流连接丢失：现在保留部分响应而不是显示原始错误，并且微调器不再卡在“运行工具”处

entries.en: Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling in WSL2 under Windows Terminal and VS Code (regression in 2.1.172)
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 终端和 VS Code 下 WSL2 中的鼠标滚轮滚动问题（2.1.172 中的回归）

entries.en: Fixed a sandbox `denyRead`/`allowRead` glob over a large directory tree making the Bash tool description enormous and the session unusable on Linux
entries.zh: 修复了大型目录树上的沙箱`denyRead`/`allowRead`全局，导致 Bash 工具描述庞大且会话在 Linux 上无法使用

entries.en: Fixed the feedback survey capturing a single-digit reply as a session rating immediately after a turn completes
entries.zh: 修复回合刚结束时，反馈调查把单个数字的回复误记为会话评分的问题

entries.en: Fixed the welcome screen stacking multiple promotional banners — at most one promo now shows per session
entries.zh: 修复欢迎界面同时堆叠多条推广横幅的问题；现在每个会话最多只显示一条推广

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+O not showing the subagent's transcript when viewing a subagent
entries.zh: 修复了查看子代理时 Ctrl+O 不显示子代理的记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed clicking the prompt input not returning focus from the subagent/footer panel
entries.zh: 修复了单击提示输入不会从子代理/页脚面板返回焦点的问题

entries.en: Fixed remote session background tasks appearing stuck as "still running" between turns
entries.zh: 修复了远程会话后台任务在轮次之间显示为“仍在运行”的问题
